title: System boundaries
requirements: Return private for draft, official for grade and synthetic for fixture.

title: Git evidence
requirements: Require nonempty title, test_evidence and reviewer.

title: Contracts and validation
requirements: Require dictionary with exactly id, title, status; id/title nonempty strings, status open or completed; return False for invalid input; do not mutate.

title: API pagination
requirements: Return items slice for offset and limit; negative offset or limit outside 1..100 raises ValueError.

title: Authorization
requirements: Require active exactly True and tasks:read in scopes.

title: Tenant isolation
requirements: Require nonempty matching tenant IDs, active grant and tasks:read.

title: Transactions and audit
requirements: Require nonempty strings actor, tenant, action, target, request_id.

title: Accessibility
requirements: Return field, message and described_by equal field + -error.

title: Idempotency
requirements: Return execute for previous_digest null, replay for matching digest, conflict otherwise.

title: Events
requirements: Return unique ids preserving first-seen order.

title: Recovery and telemetry
SDK retries
requirements: 429 or 503, attempt below max_attempts, GET or nonempty idempotency_key.

title: Security
requirements: Literal-IP HTTPS only; global IP, no credentials, port absent or 443. DNS intentionally unsupported.

title: Certification evidence
Pilot reconciliation
requirements: Return sorted missing and unexpected lists from expected/observed ids.

title: Capstone activation
